name: review
description: Review a change by its decisions, not its lines: /review-map has a fresh Opus auditor map the decisions, blast radius, door, contradictions and test gaming, an independent reviewer verdict every row and three voters cut the noise; /review-address fixes the MUST-FIX items with a re-check per fix and posts one checked reply; /review-verify has a fresh agent judge that every item was answered honestly before merge.
